data.name: Ship's Bell
data.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Binding Ring): the bell tolls; push 3 and a 1-round lock inside the ring.

effects.description: Redirects the target towards or away from the user by power number of spaces
Seals the target's ability to use all elemental 60 AP jutsu
Increases AP cost of actions by 10

data.battleDescription: %user strikes the deck with his blade. "All hands." The great bell answers.

data.name: Broadside
data.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Rows, set A): the ship's guns fire down the marked rows.

data.name: Command Absolute
data.description: Crowned Captain signature (Omen: Last Light, Binding): everywhere but the stars, a 2-round lock: elemental jutsu sealed, +10 AP per action, Move and Replacement Technique +2 cooldown.

effects.description: Seals the target's ability to use all elemental 60 AP jutsu
Increases AP cost of actions by 10

data.name: Crownfall
data.description: Crowned Captain signature (Omen: Lines): crown shards fall along the fan.
data.battleDescription: %user tilts his head, and shards of the crown fall like blades.

data.name: Maw of the Deep
data.description: Core Horror signature (Omen: Last Light): black water and teeth everywhere but the stars; Exposed Seam, x3 damage taken for 1 round.

effects.description: Extra raw damage from specific things

data.battleDescription: %user sinks into the deck, and black water and teeth rise from every plank. The mass splits open along a glowing seam.

data.name: Quench
data.description: Foundry Warden signature (Omen: Last Light): steam everywhere but the cooled tiles; Cooling Shell, x3 damage taken for 1 round.

effects.description: Extra raw damage from specific things

data.battleDescription: %user tips seawater onto the melt. The room explodes in steam.

data.name: Lowered Guard
data.description: Shared window: the caster takes x3 damage for 1 round.

effects.description: Extra raw damage from specific things

data.battleDescription: %user lowers their guard for one breath.

data.name: Binding: Seal Cross
data.description: Strikes the ground its omen marked.

effects.description: Seals the target's ability to use all elemental 60 AP jutsu
Increases AP cost of actions by 10

data.battleDescription: %user closes the cross, and the marked lines bind whoever stands on them.

data.name: Chain Hook
data.description: A weighted chain hooks a target, drags them in and pins them.

effects.description: Redirects the target towards or away from the user by power number of spaces

data.battleDescription: %user hurls a weighted chain and drags %target across the deck.

data.name: Stonebound Summons
data.description: Calls a Crown Stonebound to fight at the caster's side. Only one answers at a time.

effects.description: Summon an ally for a certain number of rounds. Its stats are scaled to same total as the summoner, modified by the power of the jutsu as a percentage.

data.battleDescription: %user breaks a seal in the air, and a Crown Stonebound steps out of the light.

data.name: Recall
data.description: The crown calls an officer of Crownhold back out of chakra haze. It stands for as long as he commands.

effects.description: Summon an ally for a certain number of rounds. Its stats are scaled to same total as the summoner, modified by the power of the jutsu as a percentage.

data.battleDescription: "Stand, soldier." An echo rises at his word.

data.name: The Crown's Will
data.description: The Command Crown answers its wearer. Its frost points glint, and every echo in the hall stands straighter.
data.battleDescription: %user does not rise. "Another echo come home."

data.name: Keelbind
data.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.
data.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

data.name: Final Command
data.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.
data.battleDescription: %user drives a command seal toward %target with a crushing blow, its flaring script threatening to scatter their rhythm and suppress their bloodline power.

data.name: Unbroken Command
data.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
data.battleDescription: %user draws upon an unbroken command imprint, old orders burning through their reconstructed form as their offensive power rises.

data.name: Core Rupture
data.description: A containment seal ruptures, destroying the casting device in a piercing chakra blast that staggers nearby enemies.
data.battleDescription: %user's containment seal splits, consuming the device in a piercing chakra blast that tears through the surrounding battlefield.

data.name: Echo of Erupting Ground
data.description: Shared pool record A3. Balance values pending sign-off. (Skyglass copy: damage hits enemies only.)
data.battleDescription: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

jutsu.name: Core Rupture
jutsu.description: A containment seal ruptures, destroying the casting device in a piercing chakra blast that staggers nearby enemies.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's containment seal splits, consuming the device in a piercing chakra blast that tears through the surrounding battlefield.

item.name: AI Heavy Armor
item.description: Heavy dmg reduction item for AI

jutsu.name: Withering Weave
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B36. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user threads a wasting current of chakra through %target like a needle through silk. The weave wounds them, softens their defenses, and slows their recovery.

jutsu.name: Sundering Blow
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S44. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user brings a sundering blow down on %target with chakra packed behind it. The strike lands with enough force to split a wooden gate.

jutsu.name: Echo of Erupting Ground
jutsu.description: Shared pool record A3. Balance values pending sign-off. (Skyglass copy: damage hits enemies only.)
jutsu.battleDescription: %user forms the Boar seal and pours chakra deep into the earth beneath %target. The ground heaves and bursts upward in a column of rock and soil, battering everyone caught above it.

jutsu.name: Venom Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S29. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slashes %target with a blade wet with poison. The venom seeps into their blood, burning away health, chakra and stamina as it spreads.

jutsu.name: Veilstrike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B24. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slips into shadow beneath a veil of chakra, tending their wounds as they vanish. When they move again, their blows will land harder and the strikes against them softer.

jutsu.name: Windlash Focus
jutsu.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

jutsu.name: Omen: Fore Rows
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user sweeps an arm across the field, and two rows of floor glow red.

jutsu.name: Unbroken Command
jutsu.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws upon an unbroken command imprint, old orders burning through their reconstructed form as their offensive power rises.

jutsu.name: Unraveling Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S31. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

jutsu.name: Ship's Bell
jutsu.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Binding Ring): the bell tolls; push 3 and a 1-round lock inside the ring.

effects.description: Redirects the target towards or away from the user by power number of spaces
Seals the target's ability to use all elemental 60 AP jutsu
Increases AP cost of actions by 10

jutsu.battleDescription: %user strikes the deck with his blade. "All hands." The great bell answers.

jutsu.name: Steady the Helm
jutsu.description: The Captain falls back to his helm and takes command of the deck. He shakes off whatever holds him, and for 2 rounds he takes far less damage, turns part of it aside, and cannot be stripped of his guard.

effects.description: Clears all negative effects from the target

jutsu.battleDescription: %user falls back to the helm and sets both hands on the rail. "Steady. Steady."

jutsu.name: Omen: Chain Ring
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a violet seal in the air, and a ring of script binds the floor around them.

jutsu.name: Broadside
jutsu.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Rows, set A): the ship's guns fire down the marked rows.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user drops his raised hand. "Fire."

jutsu.name: Suppression Writ
jutsu.description: A command seal weakens the target's attacks, leaves them more vulnerable, and impairs their healing ability.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user casts a suppression writ upon %target, its tightening script dulling their strikes, opening their guard, and disrupting their healing chakra.

jutsu.name: Raise the Gunwale
jutsu.description: The Captain hauls up a wall of ship's timber bound in seal script. It blocks the way and has its own health: break it down or go around.

effects.description: Creates a barrier with level corresponding to power

jutsu.battleDescription: %user stamps the deck, and a wall of timber and seal script rises along the gunwale.

jutsu.name: Battle Trance
jutsu.description: Heightened strength of body and mind.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user enters a battle trance, strength rising.

jutsu.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

jutsu.name: Keelbind
jutsu.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

jutsu.name: Second Wind
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

jutsu.name: Counter Stance
jutsu.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

jutsu.name: Stolen Form
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B07. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

jutsu.name: Final Command
jutsu.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user drives a command seal toward %target with a crushing blow, its flaring script threatening to scatter their rhythm and suppress their bloodline power.

jutsu.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

jutsu.name: Second Wind
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

jutsu.name: Counter Stance
jutsu.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

jutsu.name: Stolen Form
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B07. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

jutsu.name: Final Command
jutsu.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user drives a command seal toward %target with a crushing blow, its flaring script threatening to scatter their rhythm and suppress their bloodline power.

item.name: Cursed Dagger
item.description: New item description
item.battleDescription: %user swipes at %target with the Cursed Dagger, leaving lasting wounds that can't be mended by normal means

item.name: AI Heavy Armor
item.description: Heavy dmg reduction item for AI

jutsu.name: Core Rupture
jutsu.description: A containment seal ruptures, destroying the casting device in a piercing chakra blast that staggers nearby enemies.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's containment seal splits, consuming the device in a piercing chakra blast that tears through the surrounding battlefield.

item.name: AI Heavy Armor
item.description: Heavy dmg reduction item for AI

jutsu.name: Windlash Focus
jutsu.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

jutsu.name: Omen: Fore Rows
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user sweeps an arm across the field, and two rows of floor glow red.

jutsu.name: Unbroken Command
jutsu.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws upon an unbroken command imprint, old orders burning through their reconstructed form as their offensive power rises.

jutsu.name: Unraveling Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S31. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

jutsu.name: Ship's Bell
jutsu.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Binding Ring): the bell tolls; push 3 and a 1-round lock inside the ring.

effects.description: Redirects the target towards or away from the user by power number of spaces
Seals the target's ability to use all elemental 60 AP jutsu
Increases AP cost of actions by 10

jutsu.battleDescription: %user strikes the deck with his blade. "All hands." The great bell answers.

jutsu.name: Steady the Helm
jutsu.description: The Captain falls back to his helm and takes command of the deck. He shakes off whatever holds him, and for 2 rounds he takes far less damage, turns part of it aside, and cannot be stripped of his guard.

effects.description: Clears all negative effects from the target

jutsu.battleDescription: %user falls back to the helm and sets both hands on the rail. "Steady. Steady."

jutsu.name: Omen: Chain Ring
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a violet seal in the air, and a ring of script binds the floor around them.

jutsu.name: Broadside
jutsu.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Rows, set A): the ship's guns fire down the marked rows.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user drops his raised hand. "Fire."

jutsu.name: Suppression Writ
jutsu.description: A command seal weakens the target's attacks, leaves them more vulnerable, and impairs their healing ability.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user casts a suppression writ upon %target, its tightening script dulling their strikes, opening their guard, and disrupting their healing chakra.

jutsu.name: Raise the Gunwale
jutsu.description: The Captain hauls up a wall of ship's timber bound in seal script. It blocks the way and has its own health: break it down or go around.

effects.description: Creates a barrier with level corresponding to power

jutsu.battleDescription: %user stamps the deck, and a wall of timber and seal script rises along the gunwale.

jutsu.name: Battle Trance
jutsu.description: Heightened strength of body and mind.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user enters a battle trance, strength rising.

jutsu.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.
